# Correlation Test

![Correlation Test function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/32-correlation_test.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Correlation alternatives follow NI reversed mapping: -1 positive,+1 negative,0 two-sided. Rank-test methods and ties are GS explicit, not an automatic Pearson substitution. Type 0 Pearson, 1 Spearman, 2 Kendall tau-b. Alternative -1 greater, 0 different, +1 less; other hypothesis functions use -1 less/+1 greater.
